title: China and the Modern West
description: Survey of modern Chinese history with an emphasis on China's relations to the West from 1840 to 2010. Topics include China's responses to Western challenges and early modernization, its Republican, Nationalist and Communist revolutions and its recent reforms and rise as a global power.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PAAS 265B, HIST 254, HSTR 265B, PACI 254.
recommendations: Recommended for students wishing to take advanced courses in Chinese history.
